name: Elder Wren
title: Keeper of the Waking Ring
examine: She came out of the stones herself, fifty years back. The knitting never stops and the eyes never miss a waker's first step.
lines: The frost came off the stones in a ring this morning. That always means somebody.
Rowan kept this Ring before me. He finally took his own advice and walked east.
Fifty years of wakings and I still count them. You were one of mine, you know.
